sentiment: Every lasting thing is a small thing someone refused to abandon, and a rule they chose to keep.

stories.title: Show HN: SimCity, but with Permits
stories.summary: A city-builder where the fun is the paperwork — proof that constraint, not open space, is what makes imagination legible.

stories.title: Good type against all odds
stories.summary: A study of letterforms that stay beautiful under hostile conditions — craft persisting in places nothing required it to.

stories.title: Four Years with Decker
stories.summary: Four years of keeping a small creative tool alive — a quiet argument that tending one thing long enough is its own kind of making.
